repository_hash_encoding: UTF-8 bytes with CRLF normalized to LF, matching Git text blobs

profile.tiling: Single image up to 512 pixels per edge retains instance masks. Larger images: 512-pixel tiles, stride 384, row-major, final tile anchored to far edge, no padding. Union foreground at source pixel coordinates and retain maximum accepted instance confidence per pixel; connected regions become review candidates.

per_building.matching: Maximum cardinality one-to-one, total IoU tie-break; actual production polygon-candidate masks; zero-pixel source features retained as unmatched

boundary_f1_2px.scope: Micro pooled full-chip foreground union boundaries; includes false boundaries on empty chips

abstention.note: Empty predictions are scored, not treated as abstention

limitations: No spatial buffer between adjacent cells; this measures held-out grid-cell performance, not independent acquisition/city performance.
Installed checkpoint pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out.
Publisher roof features are not surveyed ground footprints or independent property records.
Publisher label completeness/occlusion uncertainty is not independently audited; no relabelling or ignore-mask invention.
Results are roofprint candidates, not legal/registry or surveyed footprint truth.
